lines.en: Like you I tried to fix what I didn't understand and made it worse. (Persuade)
Choose your next words carefully, Dovahkiin. What is it that you 'made worse'?
You compare yourself to me? I have no time for the ramblings of one so crude.
What happened at the Jarl's tournament?
I was a girl not even flowered, and the crowd behind me laughed and jeered when I requested to enter my name in the archers' list.
From his view atop the Sky-Forge, he'd seen me grow from a child who could barely nock an arrow to one who could bulls-eye a flea.
Wait here, Strahg.
No! No! No leaving, no leaving! Theys always wander off!
Strahg will remember that!
No surprises, no, no... Strahg on lookout!
Ok, let's keep going.
Good, lead the way.
Already on the move.
Glad to hear it.
Right behind you.
Ready when you are.
After you get your revenge, what happens to us?
That's not something I can answer right now.
"To us?" What're you saying?
Do you seek alms like the others?
I don't need your charity. Neither do the people. It only serves to delay their suffering.
Yes. Take the sick one, Cairine. She lies all day in her own filth, gripping her stomach in pain.
You Tojay-raht really don't take kindly to the Thalmor, do you?
Ah, so the Thalmor found Dervar, yes? Mervar take it they are no more? Good work. Keep the key, perhaps Dervar will have need of you in the future.
Ah, so the Thalmor found Dervar, yes? Mervar take it they are no more? Good work. Keep the key. Perhaps Dervar will have need of you in the future.
Depends on the price.
Ha! Too cheap for how good it tastes!
Good! I'll make you a good deal. You won't regret it.
This place is flooding, we have to get out now!
What?! I need that necklace! Damn it, I'm going to find it, if it's the last thing I do!
What? What am I supposed to do?
Can you give me the pants?
Sorry, traveler. We need to learn the enchantment from these pants so we can transpose a new magical artifact.
I...uhh... Don't know where I left them. I swore I had them a few moments ago.
Sorry traveler, we already completed the ritual. The pants are dust. You can have the dust though.
Altano is dead.
No... Did you kill him?
Did you... did you kill him?
I couldn't find an antidote. (Lie)
*sigh* So these are my final days. May death greet me as an old friend.
There has to be! Please look in every corner on Wyrmstooth! There got to be a cure!
How so?
Khajiit are servants to the Thalmor now. Verina can see brightly in the darkness and it seems these servants have gone on strike.
Khajiit are servants to the Thalmor now. Verina can see brightly in the darkness and it seems these servants have gone on strike.
What can you tell me about Amber Creek?
Amber Creek is named after the small stream it was built next to. The stream was, at the time, full of a rich mineral called Amber.
It was founded when the Borvaldurs left Borvald a few years after its construction. Olav wanted something more peaceful.
Actually, you should keep your current mount for now.
OK. My current steed was getting worried there.
Fair enough. My steed and I are quite happy to keep things as they are.
Have you been working on anything new lately?
Well, now that you mention it...
Okay, what do you want to talk about?
Stop casting Frostbite.
Too chilly for you? No problem, I can reign it in.
Ah, splendid. I'll make sure our enemies get a... frosty reception.
Do you know anything about this ring?
By the gods, that's the ring from Svea's shop! You should bring that to her right away. She'll definitely be interested in it!
A man came through here a few days ago asking about some ring. Some kind of lost treasure. That could certainly be it.
I'm not too sure. A man briefly passed through here before heading to Amber Creek, said he was looking for something like that. You can ask him.
That looks like the ring from the general store here in Amber Creek. If it really is, Svea would definitely want to see it. You should go show her!
Answer me or you'll lose more than your patrons. (Intimidate)
Listen. You want me to tell you so badly? Make me.
Not going to happen.
CYRPickpocketWarning
Don't even think about it, footpad.
I swear, if you even lay a finger on my pockets...
I know you're there. I hope you're not trying to pickpocket me.
Take a single septim from my pockets and you'll soon find yourself in a jail cell.
